description: This Java class, DeleteGuarantorCommandHandler, handles the deletion of guarantors in a loan management system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes delete commands, and invokes the GuarantorWritePlatformService to perform the removal.

classes.name: DeleteGuarantorCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of guarantors associated with loans, utilizing GuarantorWritePlatformService to perform the removal upon receiving process commands.

methods.name: DeleteGuarantorCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the GuarantorWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command to remove a guarantor using the GuarantorWritePlatformService.
